title: Add a configuration property to customize the Tomcat connector's max parameter count

timeline.body: To align with [embedded Tomcat's own default](https://github.com/apache/tomcat/blob/b42637028c26a6012da1e106c3b1aeff623aeace/java/org/apache/catalina/connector/Connector.java#L213), this should be an `int` with a value of `10000`. We can then add a test to ensure that our default and Tomcat's default are in sync.
I think it's worth documenting that the limit can be disabled by specifying a value that is less than zero.
Thanks for the PR, @quaff. I've left a couple of comments for your consideration.
Is `@ParameterizedTest` required here to test negative value? @wilkinsona

reply.body: I don't think so. Given that all three values are passed through and then returned by `getMaxParameterCount()` without any having special treatment, I think testing with a single value would be sufficient.

timeline.message:
Add configuration property to customize the Tomcat connector's max parameter

Closes GH-43275
timeline.author: Yanming Zhou

timeline.body: I’m curious—could you explain where and how this is used for conditional checks? I’d love to learn more about it.

reply.body: What do you mean by "conditional checks"? You can review the other changes in this PR to see how this property's value will be used.
Could you help me understand which component or method uses this attribute during request parsing? Looking forward to your explanation!
That's not our code, Tomcat would use the value set. The `factory.addConnectorCustomizers((connector) -> connector.setMaxParameterCount(maxParameterCount));` line passes the value along.
